title: Include dotfolders in Indexing for @-referencing if they are not gitignored
body:
I wonder why .folders/.files are not included in the file indexing that is used for @-referencing files and folders.

It would be helpful to have them included as well. Claude Code does read them if just typed manually but the auto complete would certainly help enjoying life more 😀
author: Helmi

top_comments.author: ollie-anthropic
top_comments.body: Hey all, hidden files should be available now for searching in the latest release (v1.0.64) :)

top_comments.author: jvaill
top_comments.body: In react-router framework mode (remix), [`.server` directories can be used to contain server-only modules](https://reactrouter.com/api/framework-conventions/server-modules#server-directories). I'm really enjoying Claude Code and supporting dot directories would make working with it that much more awesome 😃
